Last time on @colbertlateshow! Tune in — some fun surprises 

Photo by @skpnyc

diGenova was sued after he said publicly that a former Trump administration official who didn’t back the election lies “should be drawn and quartered. Taken out at dawn and shot." 

The official sued him and diGenova was forced to apologize. 

So: an über-loyalist.


Victoria Toensing (@VicToensing)

Hubby being sworn in as Counsel to the Attorney General.





— https://nitter.net/VicToensing/status/2046243651727028316#m

Heartbreaking. May Madison’s memory be a blessing. Prayers for the Warners 🙏


Mark Warner (@MarkWarner)
